title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.tools.search tool
_comment: WP-Q03 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §5.2 #1, §1.1). tools.search is READ-ONLY (readOnlyHint/idempotentHint, side:TS — pure local registry, no REST). Runs UNCONDITIONALLY: no disposable draft, no capability gate. MINIMAL valid input per the §1.1 inputSchema: every field is optional ({query?, prefix?, limit?}); we set a single free-text `query` so the call exercises the real matcher. The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {tools[], total}. tools.search is the ★ enabler (it enable()s matched advanced tools + sendToolListChanged), so it must be present + callable in the lean profile.
